# Organizational Actions

## Datasets

New datasets may be tracked from asset inventories, program announcements, and press releases.

## Applications

Applications may be found on data catalogs as external tool, code repositories, or web pages that provide context of their purpose.

## Map Applications

Maps, map applications, and hub sites developed on ArcGIS Online may be found in data catalogs.

## Data Narratives and Visualizations

Data stories created by departments that show current conditions and the results of program actions

## Standards and Practices

- Data portal as the standard

- Data catalog – inclusive (GIS, community)

- Data quality

## Support

- Support platform

- Communication channels

- Office hours

## Education Content

- Articles

- Videos

- Case studies

## Providing Context

Examples of how to add context to include:

- New datasets created through public information requests

- New datasets created from actions, resolutions, and directives made by Council, Mayor, or other local government authority

- New datasets created from legal settlements.

- New datasets created from multiple organizations that share ownership of source data and require coordination.

- New datasets created (crowd-sourced) by community members for data not collected by local government organizations.

- New datasets initiated from audit recommendations

- New datasets initiated from department initiatives

- Created to aid emergency response
